name: qv100
description: NVIDIA Quadro GV100 (GV100, Volta, sm_70) at its 1132 MHz base clock: one Vortex core per SM; the chip is the V100's (v100).

sources.SM (all core knobs), NUM_CORES, L2: Inherited from v100: Quadro GV100 is a full GV100 (80 SMs, 5120 CUDA cores, 640 tensor cores, 6 MB L2)
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_DATA_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMO: 4 HBM2 stacks x 8 128-bit channels = 32 channels at 1700 MT/s: 32 x 16 B x 1700 MT/s = 870.4 GB/s (Quadro GV100 data sheet: 870 GB/s)
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 1132 MHz base clock (1627 MHz boost), the clock of Accel-Sim's SM7_QV100 configuration
sources.L2_LINK_LATENCY, PLATFORM_MEMORY_LATENCY: Inherited from v100 (same die, SM-to-L2 network and HBM2), calibrated there against Jia et al.'s V100 pointer chase
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. Latencies inherited from v100 (Jia et al., V100: same GV100 die). Accel-Sim (accel-sim-framework) correlates this card: GPGPU-Sim tested-cfg SM7_QV100 and posted hardware runs (volta-quadro-v100)
